title: Any-Dimensional Learning by Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2607.07680v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many machine learning models are defined for inputs of different sizes, such as point clouds containing different numbers of points, sequences of tokens of different lengths, and graphs on different numbers of nodes. Such models are trained on finitely many examples of necessarily limited sizes. How well do these models generalize from inputs of small size to larger inputs of size not seen during training? Furthermore, evaluating such models on large inputs is often expensive. How can we sketch large inputs to obtain smaller ones on which the model takes similar values? At the heart of both questions is the need to compare inputs of different sizes and to approximate large inputs by small ones. We present a unified approach to address these questions by using random sampling maps to compare inputs of different sizes. The sampling maps we consider are generalizations of sampling with replacement, random binning, and species samp

translated_title: 基于采样的任意维度学习
translated_abstract: 许多机器学习模型是为不同大小的输入定义的，例如包含不同数量点的点云、不同长度的标记序列以及具有不同数量节点的图。这些模型是在有限个、必然尺寸受限的样本上进行训练的。那么，这些模型从小尺寸输入泛化到训练期间未见过的更大尺寸输入的效果如何？此外，在大输入上评估这类模型通常成本高昂。我们如何对大输入进行草图化（sketch）以获得更小的输入，使模型在其上取到相近的值？这两个问题的核心都在于比较不同大小的输入，以及用小输入来近似大输入。我们提出了一种统一的方法，通过使用随机采样映射来比较不同大小的输入，从而解决这些问题。我们所考虑的采样映射是带放回采样、随机分箱以及物种采样（species sampling）的推广。
tldr: 本文提出一种统一框架，利用随机采样映射来比较不同大小的输入，从而解决变尺寸机器学习模型从训练时的小尺寸输入向更大尺寸输入的泛化问题，以及通过草图化大输入来高效获得相似模型输出的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified framework that uses random sampling maps to compare inputs of different sizes, addressing both the generalization of variable-size machine learning models from small training inputs to larger unseen inputs and the sketching of large inputs to efficiently obtain similar model outputs.
